title: The Gem of Marrowfield

cast.name: The elder of Marrowfield
cast.about: stingy, keeps his own door half-closed while asking for favours

stakes: Recover the stolen gem from the caves above the treeline before the village loses its protection.

beats.text: The elder tasks the party with recovering the gem; offers gratitude, not payment.
First two traps in the caves found and survived; the third catches Corin — the wall gives way and he falls.
How Corin gets out of the lower grotto.
Goblin fight at the underground lake — Corin distracts the chief; the party wins.
The gem is recovered and returned. The elder is grateful. Only grateful.

outcome: Gem recovered; Corin no longer trusts walls.
